date_scope_check.qualification_retained:
H12-FU1: The Dollow bridge restriction is reported as beginning during March 2020 and continuing on April 14, with testimony referring to the previous two weeks. Month bounds do not mean the whole of March was closed. Ordinary work trips, local visits and small-scale goods traffic were affected in both directions; informal river supplies continued.

The Gedo governor’s April 9 statement names Balad Hawo, Elwak and Doolow, but supplies no exact first day at each post. The earlier bridge interviews do not identify the imposing authority or prove that the March restriction was the same measure announced by that governor. No matched ordinary reopening has been established, and later cargo or unspecified route access is not substituted for it.
